profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Capital One | Master’s in Computer Science, AWS Certified Solutions Architect
profile.summary:
As a Principal Associate Software Engineer at Capital One, I leverage my passion for solving enterprise problems and my expertise in full-stack development to create innovative solutions. With over five years of experience in the tech industry, I have developed a strong foundation in computer science, earning a Master's degree from Georgia Institute of Technology and multiple certifications, including AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and ITIL 4 Foundation.

I am always eager to learn new technologies and apply them to real-world challenges. My skills in web applications and computer ethics enable me to design and implement secure, user-friendly, and ethical software solutions. I am also proficient in using various tools and platforms, such as AWS, to ensure scalability and reliability. My goal is to continue growing as a software engineer and contributing to the advancement of technology in the financial sector.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Daily responsibility includes:
Software development and design (web/mobile)
Testing/bug fixes
Additional duties as required by management
Using html, css, react-native, and scala to provide full stack application across mobile devices and browsers

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Used ReactJs, MaterialUI, Airtable Db, SQLite, and Express to build custom full-stack web application for clients based on their needs and provided specs. Responsible for apps' aesthetics, feels and functions as well as creating a reusable Restful API.
